title: Cash Pickup Reliance in Compliance Limit Reviews of a Personal Sender Account
content:
For a limit review request on a Personal Sender Account, cash reliance for the decision window is the number of Cash Pickup payouts made on the customer's transfers in the 12 months before the request date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting.

- When it is 8 or more, 2 business days are added to the counted decision window of the limit review request.
- When it is at least 4 but fewer than 8, 1 business day is added to the counted decision window.
- When it is fewer than 4, nothing is added for cash reliance.

## The records read

Each payout made entry in the ledger of one of the customer's Cash Pickup transfers is one payout made, counted by its entry date. The amount paid out does not matter here; only the number of payouts made counts.

## Cases (hypothetical counts)

| Cash Pickup payouts made in the 12 months | Business days added |
|---|---|
| 3 | 0 |
| 4 | 1 |
| 7 | 1 |
| 8 | 2 |
| 15 | 2 |

A customer with no Cash Pickup payout made in the 12 months, whose transfers went only by Bank Deposit or Mobile Wallet, has a cash reliance of 0, and nothing is added.
